description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for AMQP adapter integration tests, including setup and teardown procedures, connection creation, and utility methods to facilitate testing of AMQP functionalities within a Vert.x environment.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for AMQP adapter integration tests using Vert.x and Proton.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Vert.x instance, configures Proton client options with SSL, and initializes the test support helper before all tests.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the helper connection and shutting down the Vert.x instance after all tests.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates and opens an AMQP sender (ProtonSender) for the specified target address, handling connection and link establishment.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the AMQP adapter using username and password, returning a future for the connection.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a secure connection to the AMQP adapter using a client certificate, returning a future for the connection.

methods.name: handleConnectAttempt
methods.description: Handles the connection attempt, sets handlers for open and close events, and verifies offered capabilities.
